image_description: A realistic photograph of a grey whale surfacing in dark blue ocean water. The whale's back and dorsal knuckles are visible breaking the surface, showing characteristic mottled grey skin with white barnacle patches. The head is partially submerged on the left, and the body extends towards the right. No flippers or tail flukes are clearly visible above the water line.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is relatively short with arched rostrum and two blowholes on top.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is mostly submerged; the rostrum and blowholes are not visible above the water line.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is mottled grey to greyish-black with distinctive white patches from barnacles and whale lice.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible skin on the back clearly shows the characteristic mottled grey coloration and white barnacle patches.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: No dorsal fin present; multiple dorsal knuckles along posterior back.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image clearly shows a series of small humps (knuckles) along the ridge of the back instead of a single dorsal fin, consistent with grey whale anatomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Robust spindle-shaped body of enormous proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible portion of the body appears massive and robust, consistent with the scale of a large whale.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is mottled grey with white patches created by barnacles.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Confirmed on the visible dorsal surface.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Baleen plates are cream-colored, densely packed in numerous rows along each side.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The mouth is closed and submerged; baleen plates are internal and not visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flippers (pectoral fins) are broad and paddle-shaped, remarkably elongated relative to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Pectoral fins are located on the underside/lateral lower body and are completely submerged/occluded by the angle and water.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail flukes are broad with smooth trailing edge and central notch.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is not visible in the frame; only the mid-section/back is shown.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin texture is rough with callosities.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The high-resolution texture of the skin shows roughness and raised areas consistent with callosities/barnacles.
